title: Websites
intro: Each website shows the listings its inventory policy selects, with its own reference prefix, languages and contact details. Website API keys are bound to one website. Changes reach the website within a minute.
empty: No websites yet. Creating an API key also creates one.

form.name: Name
form.policyHint: Network listings are other agencies' public listings shared with you; they appear under your branding.
form.anyHint: Select none for any. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) to select several.
form.priceHint: Listings priced on request are left out when a price band is set.
form.prefixHint: Up to 6 capital letters or digits, shown before network listings' references. Leave empty for none.
form.localesHint: Language codes separated by commas, the default first (en, es).
form.contact: Contact details shown on this website
form.contactHint: Leave empty to show the agency's own.

notices.saved: Website saved. Its listings follow within a minute.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can change websites.
errors.SITE_LIMIT_REACHED: Your agency has as many websites as allowed.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this website meanwhile. Reload and try again.
